Weighted Conformal Quantile

Source: R/gam_adaptive_pi.R
weighted_conformal_quantile.Rd

The 1 - alpha quantile of the scores, where each compound counts by its outlier weight, so that compounds the fit treats as outliers (wrong annotations) do not set the width of the interval.

Usage

weighted_conformal_quantile(scores, w, alpha)

Arguments

scores

Normalized residuals |e| / s(x).

w

Sigmoid outlier weights of the compounds.

alpha

Significance level.

Value

The multiplier q.

Details

The smallest score at which the cumulative weight of the sorted scores reaches (1 - alpha) * (sum(w) + max(w)); the extra max(w) stands for the new compound, assumed to be well annotated. With equal weights this is the split-conformal ceiling((n + 1) * (1 - alpha))-th smallest score. If the total weight is too small to reach that level (fewer than about 1 / alpha well-fitting compounds), the largest score of the compounds with at least half the maximum weight is used.

References

Tibshirani, R. J., Barber, R. F., Candès, E. J. & Ramdas, A. (2019). Conformal prediction under covariate shift. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32.
